mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE and increase in PAYEMS indicates a tightening labor market that drives corporate hiring and revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), robust demand supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO below 104.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, which typically reduces corporate output and profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in INDPRO above 0.5% signals expanding manufacturing output, which typically supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST and RSAFS indicates strong economic activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST rising and RSAFS rising does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and margin compression, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.
